name: Granite Pare
description: Draw the knife from guard and cut across the target in a clean rising line.

name: Choil Assault
description: Jab the point along the line of the knuckles into the opponent's open hand or wrist.

name: Chime Bolster
description: Turn the blade over the outer wrist to deflect a cut from the side.

name: Siltpeel
description: Brace the lead foot and pivot the body out of the path of an incoming blow.

name: Splintering Thumbramp
description: Feed qi into the curved belly of the edge and slash across the opponent's guard.

name: Toxinpeel
description: Cut into the opponent's wrist the instant their blade starts to move and break the stroke.

name: Gyve Shave
description: Cross the blades and lock the opponent's edge against the crossguard with a qi-braced wrist.

name: Plungebarrage
description: Drive qi through all primary meridians and rush in with a straight hard cut.

name: Glamour Swedge
description: Parry a blow with a qi-hardened edge and send its force back along the incoming line.

name: Gust Edgebelly
description: Test the edge with a light cut that shows how much qi it will carry.

name: Might Lanyard
description: Pass the edge through the target in one long straight draw without a pause.

name: Blazeshave
description: Pull the edge back and forth through tough material in a short sawing motion.

name: Hoarfrost Scales
description: Drop the lead shoulder behind the flat of the blade and take a blow on the edge guard.

name: Gustslit
description: Count a fixed pace of steps so each cut lands at the same measured distance.

name: Blaze Tangpin
description: Warm the edge with qi until it bites through padding and leather in a slice.

name: Trim Barrage
description: Wrap qi around the forearm sinews and cut with the whole arm behind the blade.

name: Racing Whittle
description: Shift weight side to side in a tide-like step and cut at the end of each shift.

name: Rupturing Slit
description: Draw a qi-loaded edge down a seam in armor and part the plates apart.

name: Buttcap Torment
description: Gather a deep draught of qi along the edge and pass it through the target in one long slice.

name: Blaze Plunge
description: Touch the target with the field that rings the edge and cut along the same line.

name: Glintplunge
description: Poke the point to the edge of the opponent's reach and read how they answer.

name: Chimechoil
description: Loosen the wrist and turn the blade so a strike glances away without a clash.

name: Gust Bolster
description: Glide along the edge of the qi field in a straight line toward the opponent.

name: Scalesassault
description: Sweep the field-ringed edge in a broad arc to keep several foes from stepping in.

name: Unmaking Slit
description: Wrap the tip in field qi and thrust through a guard that the blade alone could not part.

name: Gust Pare
description: Extend the living field a hand's length past the edge and cut through the longer reach.

name: Annealed Plunge Cuirass
description: Close the field around the body and the blade as a sustained shield against several strikes.

name: Shave Torment
description: Open the exchange with a cut from just past the distance the opponent expects.

name: Splintering Buttcap
description: Lunge the point forward on a measured step that stretches the knife's usual reach.

name: Plungethrash
description: Cut and snap the blade back to guard before the opponent can answer.

name: Plungegreave
description: Slip the edge along an incoming weapon and let it pass over the shoulder.

name: Silt Scales
description: Take a long step inside the opponent's reach before their blade comes around.

name: Invigorating Lanyard
description: Let the qi field map the distance and speed of every blade near the user.

name: Mayhem Peel
description: Hide the true reach of the blade in the field so the opponent guards short.

name: Lancing Choil
description: Carry the cut on the field so that it lands slightly past the blade's tip.

name: Edgebelly Spurt
description: Rush across a wide gap with field-aided steps and cut at the end of the rush.

name: Thumbramp Onslaught
description: Whip a thin crescent of qi off the edge to strike at a distance.

name: Scorching Tangpin
description: Hold a ring of sweeping cuts around the body that forbids any approach within the field.

name: Slitthrash
description: Plant both feet and cut straight through the target without moving the stance.

name: Ironchoil
description: Pivot on the lead foot and swing the cut around the line of the opponent's guard.

name: Ravaging Whittle
description: Reverse the grip and draw the edge back toward the body through the target.

name: Chimescales
description: Slide the blade up the incoming strike and turn the force away from the body.

name: Silt Lanyard
description: Step along one straight line toward and away from the opponent without crossing the feet.

name: Remnant Swedge
description: Check the opponent's breath against the user's own to find where the rhythm breaks.

name: Swedgebarrage
description: Slice through the opponent's guard with the living field riding along the edge.

name: Rumble Thumbramp
description: Hook the edge around the opponent's weapon then return with a cut along the arm.

name: Hoarfrost Shave
description: Cut across the opponent's weapon arm and bind the blade against it in one pass.

name: Mayhem Swedge
description: Strike the opponent's forearm with the spine and qi to break the weapon hand's grip.

name: Harrowing Peel
description: Deliver the refined cut of long practice with the full field behind a single stroke.

name: Keen Plunge
description: Flow from guard into a close thrust that finds the gap before any answer forms.

name: Might Bolster
description: Draw one blade and cut while the other hand readies the second blade.

name: Blazetrim
description: Curve the cut in a bend like a river around a stone and slice the flank.

name: Harpooning Tangpin
description: Thrust low along the ground line into the knee or shin of the opponent.

name: Unbroken Scales
description: Cross both forearms with the blades flat to stop a descending cut.

name: Silttrim
description: Skim forward in short quick steps like wading a shallow ford.

name: Harrowing Trim
description: Cross both knives in a scissoring slash that closes on the opponent's arm.

name: Edgebelly Cloak
description: Turn the blade like a current around a rock and send the blow off line.

name: Steel Peel
description: Run forward in a low line with both tips thrusting in alternate beats.

name: Iron Trim
description: Bring both blades together on one point like two rivers joining in a single heavy cut.

name: Siltchoil
description: Gather qi and then sweep both edges in a wide flood of cuts that fills the ground around.

name: Iron Buttcap
description: Drop from above in a steep stoop and cut across the opponent's shoulder.

name: Rumble Choil
description: Curl the fingers into a talon grip and jab the point at a joint.

name: Annealed Swedge
description: Fold the arms in like wings and cover the chest behind the blade.

name: Mightchoil
description: Land from a leap on balanced feet ready to cut again.

name: Mightshave
description: Rake the edge in parallel strokes down the opponent's guard arm.

name: Perceptive Buttcap
description: Fix a sharp gaze on the opponent's wrist and read each turn before it lands.

name: Gust Plunge
description: Dive low past the guard and hook the edge up behind the knee.

name: Trimtorment
description: Leap high and fall onto the opponent with a qi-heavy edge in one steep stroke.

name: Chime Thumbramp
description: Hold a hovering guard in which the blade sheds every strike aimed above the waist.

name: Rumble Slit
description: Slip the edge through the guard like a current finding a gap in reeds.

name: Scalding Peel
description: Turn the wrist in a small eddy and jab through the opening it makes.

name: Trouncing Bolster
description: Draw the blade low and level along the lines of a streambed through the target.

name: Gust Tangpin
description: Bend with a blow like a reed and let the blade guide it past.

name: Torrent Trim
description: Cross the distance in quick sure steps like crossing a ford over stones.

name: Veritychoil
description: Read the push and pull of the opponent's movement as if reading a current.

name: Plungetorment
description: Pull the edge back along the lower line like an undercurrent dragging at the legs.

name: Tempered Shave
description: Spin the wrist in a tight circle and cut as the circle pulls in the weapon arm.

name: Iron Whittle
description: Cut two crossing arcs like two currents meeting at the opponent's wrist.

name: Murk Choil
description: Meet the strike like a river stone and spring the blade back for a cut.

name: Sanguine Slit
description: Rush forward in a torrent of qi and slice through the guard at full speed.

name: Gyveslit
description: Hold the opponent's weapon in a sustained swirl of qi that drags it against the blade.

name: Scales Barrage
description: Open with a cut on the body track while qi readies the second track.

name: Rumble Tangpin
description: Send the thrust along the qi track so the point lands ahead of the arm.

name: Wrecking Edgebelly
description: Draw the edge on pure body mechanics with no qi so the cut hides its strength.

name: Murk Swedge
description: Switch from body guard to qi guard mid-parry to defeat a changing blow.

name: Silt Shave
description: Alternate heavy body steps with light qi steps to break the opponent's timing.

name: Verity Scales
description: Check that body and qi are in balance before committing to the next stroke.

name: Peel Torment
description: Answer a cut with a counter that begins on one track and lands on the other.

name: Blaze Slit
description: Cross a qi cut over a body cut so the two arrive from different angles.

name: Gyve Pare
description: Bind the opponent's blade at the point where the two tracks cross.

name: Sanguine Bolster
description: Bring the qi track and body track to one edge and land a single heavy cut.

name: Steadfast Verity Thumbramp
description: Take a strike on one track and rebound its force back through the other.

name: Rumble Plunge
description: Draw and cut with the wind at the back so the blade moves without wasted force.

name: Swedgeassault
description: Slice across the line of the wind and let the gust carry the edge through.

name: Ironshave
description: Thrust on a firm plateau stance that sends the whole body weight behind the point.

name: Torrent Choil
description: Turn the blade into a passing gust of wind and push the strike aside.

name: Glancing Pare
description: Hold a set bearing across the ground while stepping to keep the opponent in line.

name: Choilbarrage
description: Slash with the edge raised on a sworn oath that the stroke will not waver.

name: Swedgegreave
description: Parry facing into the wind so its pressure helps push the strike away.

name: Soaring Lanyard
description: Run across open ground and cut as the opponent turns to meet the charge.

name: Rupturing Trim
description: Rise into a cut on a surge of qi that rushes upward like a gale.

name: Thorn Edgebelly
description: Hold a guard in which a standing wind of qi circles the body and blade.

name: Mighttrim
description: Cut along a bearing fixed before the stroke begins and never let it drift.

name: Peelthrash
description: Thrust along a held bearing so the point finds the same spot on every try.

name: Murk Buttcap
description: Turn the edge to the bearing of the strike and slide the blow off to the side.

name: Might Whittle
description: Shift to a new bearing in one step and hold it against the opponent's turn.

name: Rupturing Choil
description: Cut across the wide ground in a long diagonal stroke that closes the distance.

name: Choilhauberk
description: Parry and bring the blade back onto its bearing in a single smooth turn.

name: Rupturing Lanyard
description: Send qi down the true bearing so the cut lands where the knife was aimed.

name: Whittle Fastness
description: Cut across the opponent's weapon and fix it in place with a gust of qi.

name: Blazepeel
description: Draw the knife as if keeping a promise already given and cut at once.

name: Wrecking Pare
description: Thrust the point on a straight line sworn at the start and never turn aside.

name: Might Buttcap
description: Slice at an angle through a strong crosswind with the edge steady.

name: Equipoise Edgebelly
description: Pivot the guard on a fixed foot and turn the blow around the sworn line.

name: Careening Shave
description: Step only along the bearing sworn and never back past the starting mark.

name: Remnant Thumbramp
description: Read the wind on the skin and the blade to know when the opponent will move.

name: Pare Onslaught
description: Cross two cuts through a gust so the second follows the first before it fades.

name: Needling Peel
description: Meet an attack and return the edge on the same sworn line.

name: Granite Plunge
description: Dart forward into the wind and gain a step on an opponent who turns away.

name: Whittle Torment
description: Draw a qi-loaded edge through the guard and split it like a gust through a field.

name: Intent Slit
description: Hold a wide sweeping guard in which sworn cuts keep several attackers out of reach.

name: Harpooning Bolster
description: Draw the edge out into open ground with nothing at the back to guard.

name: Choilthrash
description: Slice in a wide flat arc that uses the whole open stance of the plateau.

name: Tearing Trim
description: Thrust forward on a firm stance with no support behind and no retreat planned.

name: Iron Swedge
description: Let the wind lift the cloak across the body and use it to hide the guard.

name: Choil Sprint
description: Stride in long steps across open ground with the eyes on the far line.

name: Renewing Tangpin
description: Taste the air and learn from it how many bodies move nearby.

name: Blaze Pare
description: Chain three cuts along a rising skyline arc without a breath between them.

name: Might Thumbramp
description: Return the edge across the line of a crosswind to catch a foe who backs away.

name: Thorn Plunge
description: Bind the opponent's weapon arm against the body with a sworn gust of qi.

name: Resilient Lanyard
description: Take a blow on a planted foot and bounce the force away across open ground.

name: Ironpare
description: Pour qi into the edge and strike with the whole weight of an open gale.

name: Facet Scales
description: Gather qi overhead and drop the point straight down through the opponent's guard.
